## Summary

Describe the problem and the change made.

## Type of change

- [ ] Bug fix
- [ ] New component or feature
- [ ] Documentation
- [ ] Performance or build tooling
- [ ] Refactoring

## Checklist

- [ ] I kept the change focused and updated related documentation.
- [ ] I preserved or updated accessibility behavior where relevant.
- [ ] I ran `npm run typecheck`.
- [ ] I ran `npm run build`.
- [ ] I ran `git diff --check`.
- [ ] I ran `npm run pack:check` when package output changed.

## Validation details

List the commands you ran and any relevant manual or browser verification.

## Screenshots or recordings

Include visual evidence for UI changes when useful.
